**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared molecular mechanisms underlying vacuolar neuromyopathy and neutral lipid storage myopathy, particularly the role of PNPLA2 and PLIN4 in lipid droplet metabolism, could pave the way for targeted therapeutic strategies aimed at restoring lipid homeostasis in muscle cells for both conditions.
